finding: Branch-local explicit evidence triggers were separated by hours while the fixed protocol only accepts outcomes 10-25 minutes after signal time, leaving schema-v4 snapshots unable to mature into outcomes.
change: Explicit evidence runs now capture a causal pair: first snapshot at signal time, then a second snapshot after 660 seconds, inside the predeclared 600000-1500000 ms maturity window. Workflow timeout increased from 5 to 20 minutes only to permit that observation interval.
expectedImpact: Makes future branch-local evidence capable of producing causal matured outcomes without relaxing signal, cost, independence, validation, walk-forward, or holdout rules.
nextBottleneck: Accumulate independent matured schema-v4 signals; current study had 2 raw snapshots and 0 matured signals before this collector fix.
